reason: It is paid in USDC on Solana, and I do not touch crypto for business spend. I would have to set up a wallet to buy a 30 dollar task, and I could not explain that to whoever signs off on my freelancer budget.
objection: I do not want to deal with crypto or a wallet to pay for a small task. On top of that it is unaudited and invite-only, so I would be defending an odd payment method on an unproven product.
would_change_my_mind: Let me pay by card or invoice in dollars, with no wallet and no stablecoin on my side, plus a receipt I can hand to finance.
